flights.cabin: Economy (1 stop via LAX • Airbus A321neo)
flights.notes: Cheapest flight ($244). Nonstop direct available at $669.

gotchas: Unbundled carry-on and checked bag fees that can quickly add to the base fare
Extremely tight 0.5-hour layover at LAX for a transcontinental routing during the December holiday peak
Winter weather risks and potential misconnects due to the ultra-short connection time
Total travel time exceeds 7 hours for what is typically a 4-hour direct flight
positive_highlights: Priced in the 1.1th percentile historically, representing massive savings of roughly $218 vs the median holiday rate
Exceptional value for peak Christmas and New Year holiday ski travel dates
Operated on a modern Airbus A321neo aircraft
audit.rationale: At the 1.1th historical percentile for Christmas week, this $244 fare offers unmatched holiday savings despite the unbundled fees. However, travelers must pack light in a personal item and be prepared for a razor-thin 30-minute connection at LAX.
